 Adem Bona (spine) has been downgraded to doubtful for Friday’s matchup with the Cavaliers. 
 Bona’s absence could lead to some extra playing time for Jabari Walker behind Joel Embiid, though LeBron James could also log some minutes as backup center in small-ball lineups.

 Forward 
 #30 
 Adem Bona (spine) is questionable to play against the Cavaliers on Friday. 
 Bona is dealing with a cervical spine sprain that could keep him out against Cleveland. Jabari Walker could return to the rotation as the backup center, though this could also mean LeBron James spends some time at the five again. 
 Joel Embiid 
 PHI 
 Center-Forward 
 #21 
 Joel Embiid (foot) is questionable for Monday’s game against the Bulls. 
 Embiid did not play in Saturday’s win over the Hornets, as it was Philadelphia’s second game in as many nights. The 7-footer remains on the injury report, which is concerning, but the 76ers would likely rather their former MVP miss games now than later in the season. Adem Bona started on Saturday, but the 76ers were also without LeBron James. With LeBron off the injury report, Bona could be headed to the bench regardless of what happens with Embiid. 
 Adem Bona 
 PHI 
 Forward 
 #30 
 Adem Bona recorded two points (1-of-3 FGs), five rebounds, three assists, one steal and one block in Saturday’s win over the Hornets. 
 With Joel Embiid out, Bona moved into the starting lineup on Saturday. Unfortunately, he produced little, as foul trouble limited him to 22 minutes. Jabari Walker, who played 19 minutes, picked up the slack, finishing with 12 points, six rebounds and one three-pointer. The 76ers don’t have a back-to-back in their four-game Week 3, so Bona’s opportunities are likely to be limited.

 Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jaylen Brown, Dean Wade and Adem Bona will start Saturday’s game against the Hornets. 
 Brown is back after sitting out Friday’s win over the Knicks, but the 76ers are giving LeBron James and Joel Embiid the night off. As a result, Wade remains a starter, and Bona starts at center.

 This will be a third straight absence for Walker, which will leave the 76ers thinner than usual down low. Adem Bona should take on a few extra minutes as the backup to Joel Embiid.

 Jabari Walker (knee) is out for Wednesday’s game against the Pacers. 
 Walker will miss a second consecutive game after leaving Saturday’s win over the Bucks in the third quarter. While his absence may give Adem Bona a few more minutes, Joel Embiid will be available after sitting out Sunday’s loss to the Pistons. 
 Jabari Walker 
 PHI 
 Forward 
 #33 
 Jabari Walker (knee) is out for Sunday’s game against the Pistons. 
 Walker limped off the court during the third quarter of Saturday’s win over the Bucks and did not return. According to the 76ers’ injury report, he’s dealing with a sore left knee. With Joel Embiid (foot) also ruled out for Sunday, Adem Bona’s playing time is likely to increase, but he isn’t worth the streaming risk in most leagues.
